fact: Sonatel states on 20 February 2026 that 2Africa, put into service in December 2025 with a nominal capacity of 180 Tbit/s, lands at a Sonatel-owned landing station in Senegal and runs on an open-access model with carrier-neutral landing stations accessible to all operators.
title: Sonatel annonce la mise en service du Câble sous - marin 2Africa, le plus performant jamais déployé en Afrique.
